source_manifest.description: Governed source manifest for domain-product declaration aggregation. Included repositories are read from repo-native declaration files in sibling Lotus repositories; platform mirrors are reserved only for repositories that have not yet completed repo-native rollout.

freshness_policy.max_allowed_age_description: Lifecycle state must reflect the latest persisted proposal event and immutable version evidence for the requested proposal.
Effective benchmark assignment for a portfolio and as-of date.
Effective benchmark constituent and weight segments across a requested window.
Completeness, freshness, and blocking coverage report for source products.
Canonical holdings and cash state for an as-of date.
Canonical index price and return source series.
Source-batch, validation, replay, DLQ, quarantine, and repair evidence.
Instrument, issuer, taxonomy, and classification source reference.
Analytics-safe market-data window with observed and ingested timestamp lineage.
Portfolio reference context for analytics sourcing and lifecycle bounds.
Policy-aware multi-section snapshot for baseline or simulation state.
Portfolio-level valuation and cash-flow input for TWR/MWR workflows.
Position-level analytics input with valuation and cash-flow provenance.
Consumer-safe reconciliation run, finding, break, and blocking evidence.
Canonical risk-free rate source series for excess-return workflows.
Deterministically ordered transaction and income ledger window.
Exposure rows must stay aligned to the benchmark performance context and resolved benchmark version for the requested as-of date.
Stateful series are recalculated from governed upstream data for the requested as-of date and window.
Concentration analytics must reflect the resolved current or simulated portfolio state for the requested as-of date.
Drawdown analytics must remain tied to the resolved return path and benchmark policy used for the requested as-of date.
Historical attribution must stay aligned to the requested as-of date, upstream return series, exposure history, and benchmark context.
Risk metrics must reflect the requested as-of date and the resolved upstream return series used for the calculation.
Rolling risk metrics must stay aligned to the requested return window and explicit risk-free treatment.

dependencies.business_purpose: Resolve canonical holdings and cash-balance context for stateful proposal simulation, workspace evaluation, and advisory lifecycle continuity.
Resolve governed instrument enrichment and classification-taxonomy context for advisory shelf construction and supportability-bounded fallback labels.
Run discretionary rebalance simulation and what-if analysis from a governed portfolio-state snapshot supplied through the current management request contract.
Resolve the linked benchmark for stateful returns-series and benchmark-exposure workflows.
Source canonical classification and instrument reference metadata for benchmark exposure grouping semantics.
Retrieve benchmark market-series component weights and aligned market observations for performance-owned benchmark context.
Resolve portfolio open-date, reporting-currency, and lifecycle reference context for governed performance products.
Source canonical portfolio return observations for stateful returns-series workflows.
Normalize governed risk-free series when the returns-series product is asked to emit risk-free return observations.
Build portfolio summary, allocation, holdings, and portfolio-review reporting sections from governed core holdings and cash state.
Build transaction and income activity sections for reporting payloads from the governed core transaction ledger window.
Resolve governed instrument, issuer, and classification reference context for concentration and attribution outputs.
Resolve governed portfolio state for concentration stateful and simulation flows.
Source historical position exposure rows for stateful historical risk attribution.
Source governed risk-free series context when rolling Sharpe requires explicit upstream risk-free treatment.
Source performance-aligned benchmark exposure rows for approved stateful active-risk attribution workflows.
Source performance-aligned portfolio and benchmark return observations for stateful risk, drawdown, rolling, and attribution workflows.
